title: Jissen! Pachi-Slot Hisshou-hou! Iron Hook: The Great Marine Adventures
native_title: 実践！パチスロ必勝法！ アイアン・フック
overview:
Head for Treasure Island!

You're the one who will find where the treasure lies!

Jissen! Pachi-Slot Hisshou-hou! Iron Hook is a pachi-slot game from Sammy built around Iron Hook: The Great Marine Adventures, a pirate-themed slot machine. Spin the three reels, chase the 7s and aim for big bonus games.

A play document screen logs your session game by game, recording each BIG bonus, REG bonus and concentration stretch along with how many spins it took, so you can study the machine and work out a winning strategy.

- Pirate-themed Iron Hook slot machine
- Play document with a full bonus history
- Memory backup save
